content.headline: One Notice, Four Versions, in Minutes
content.body: Copy a MahaTransco outage notice. Open ChatGPT or Claude. Then make more versions: Marathi, Hindi, WhatsApp, and a short social media post. You stay in control — you do not need to retype everything.
bullets: Example: a notice about a planned power cut for a transmission line
Next versions: Marathi → Hindi → WhatsApp (under 40 words) → X/Twitter (under 280 characters)
Ask the room: would you sign a cleaned-up version of the English draft?
